nodes.title: SG-4.2.1 · Depth-independent node_modules ignore rule
nodes.body:
Context: .gitignore only has `game/node_modules/`, which does not match `game/frontend/node_modules`. Desired behavior: a depth-independent `node_modules/` rule, and a unit test that reads the real .gitignore and checks the path is covered. Expected result: vendored Phaser files under any node_modules are ignored. Why: avoid tracked changes in vendored Phaser files.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the real .gitignore, when read, then it contains the line `node_modules/` and no longer contains `game/node_modules/`
- Given the real .gitignore, when a unit test evaluates path game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json, then it is reported as ignored


## Scope
- In scope: .gitignore node_modules rule
- In scope: unit test reading the real .gitignore
- Out of scope: untracking already-indexed node_modules files
- Out of scope: other .gitignore entries
- Preserve: existing .devion/* ignore entries


## Technical constraints
- Unit test must read the real .gitignore from disk, no git process


## Definition of done
- Rule replaced and test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Pure helper that tells whether a path is ignored by directory rules
nodes.description: Add game/frontend/src/lib/gitignore.ts exporting isIgnoredByDirRule(ignoreText, path) that returns true when some non-comment line ending in `/` without other slashes equals a path segment, and handles anchored rules (containing a slash) by prefix match.
acceptance_criteria: Given `node_modules/` and path a/b/node_modules/x, then true
Given `game/node_modules/` and path game/frontend/node_modules/x, then false

steps.action: Export isIgnoredByDirRule(ignoreText: string, path: string): boolean. Split into trimmed lines, skip empty and # lines. For each rule ending in '/', strip the trailing slash; if it has no '/', return true when the directory segments of the path include it; if it has a '/', return true when path starts with rule + '/'.
steps.code: export function isIgnoredByDirRule(ignoreText: string, path: string): boolean { const dirs = path.split('/').slice(0, -1); for (const raw of ignoreText.split('\n')) { const line = raw.trim(); if (!line || line.startsWith('#') || !line.endsWith('/')) continue; const rule = line.slice(0, -1); if (rule.includes('/') ? path.startsWith(rule + '/') : dirs.includes(rule)) return true; } return false; }
steps.expected: Function compiles and returns booleans per the criteria
